methodology: Fresh canister per case, implementation and trial. configure runs separately before four forced GC increments. One synchronous operation is measured using performanceCounter(0), rts_total_allocation and rts_reclaimed. Output serialization/checking executes after the counters in a separate query; expected bytes are independent oracles. Cumulative allocation includes transient allocation and synchronous GC; end-of-message GC is excluded. No empty-loop subtraction. Each implementation is separately compiled; Wasm sizes are total canister artifact sizes.

cases.name: bitcoin-legacy-sighash-verify-1-input
cases.notes: Composed transaction workflow: legacy SIGHASH_ALL then ECDSA verify of the exact digest. Native uses SHA256 and secp256k1 plugins; baseline uses bitcoin 0.2.1 transaction hashing and ecdsa 8.0.1 verifyHashed because bitcoin Ecdsa.verify would add an extra prehash. Full-width independent Python key/signature fixture. Baseline curve/key/signature setup outside measurement; native compressed-key/signature decoding inside measurement.
cases.fixture_provenance: generate-bitcoin-tx.py independent Python Bitcoin wire encoding and hashlib; BIP143 SIGHASH_ALL and BIP341 key-path SIGHASH_DEFAULT equations. ECDSA fixture generated and algebraically verified with generate-curves.py independent affine Python.
